<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity concerns:</strong> Former Election Commissioner Ashok Lavasa questioned the fairness of ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) processes, while Congress leader Gaurav Gogoi formally urged the ECI to intervene in the Nagaon Lok Sabha bye-election.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial and administrative oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has expanded the Reserve Bank of India’s authority, allowing it to remove co-operative bank boards for periods exceeding six months.</li>
  <li><strong>Civic and local governance:</strong> Tensions between the AAP and BJP escalated into physical clashes during the Delhi civic body panel elections, highlighting ongoing friction in municipal governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
</ul>
